_README: Hand-supplied CNPJs for Itaú shelf funds whose document does not yield one in its
text layer. Keyed by codigoProduto, the stable Itaú fund id from the rentabilidade
Every entry is VALIDATED on load and the run fails if an override does not:
1. resolve to a registered CNPJ in the CVM registry, and
2. share a significant word with the fund's nomeComercial on the shelf.
Rule 2 is what an unchecked override lacks. A name typed beside the wrong CNPJ
pins the pair permanently and no source can correct it -- which is exactly how
'QUANTAMENTAL GEMS FIA' stayed attached to Itaú Small Cap II's CNPJ for years.
'why' must say where the value came from, so a stale entry can be re-checked
